clips.title: The story
paras: Melor Sends Word is a summons delivered by Jorn Skyseer in the Barrens on behalf of the renowned hunter Melor Stonehoof. Rising adventurers who have proven their grit across Kalimdor are directed to Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff to receive a far more demanding trial.

Word travels fast across the plains. As an adventurer cuts their teeth in the Barrens and surrounding lands, notable hunters take notice of those who show true promise. Jorn Skyseer, keeping watch over the crossings and encampments, serves as an emissary for the elders of Hunter's Rise. He intercepts promising hunters and warriors to let them know that Melor Stonehoof, a revered mentor among the tauren, has marked out a specific path for them.

Upon climbing the heights of Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff, the seeker meets Melor himself. The elder hunter does not offer praise, but rather asks whether the adventurer possesses the resolve to venture into perilous, distant wilderness. Answering the summons unlocks testing grounds that stretch far beyond the safety of Mulgore, pitting hunters against the fiercest predators across the continent.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, friend, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
If so, young adventurer, then listen on...
